market_snapshot.text_summary: As of 31-May-2026, Nifty 50 closed at 23,450.50, up 1.2% for the week. Sensex closed at 77,100.25, up 1.1%. Bank Nifty closed at 50,500.75, up 0.8%. FIIs were net buyers of ₹8,500 crore in the last 5 sessions, continuing a positive inflow trend. DIIs were net sellers of ₹3,200 crore. India VIX is at 12.50, indicating subdued volatility. INR closed at 83.10 against USD. Key support for Nifty is at 23,200 (prior week's low, 50-DMA) and resistance at 23,600 (all-time high).

key_drivers.text_summary: Technically, Nifty is in a strong uptrend, trading above its 50-DMA (22,800) and 200-DMA (20,500). RSI(14) is at 68, indicating bullish momentum but nearing overbought territory. MACD shows a bullish crossover. The Nifty PE ratio is 28.5, above its 10-year average of 22. Global markets are mixed, with US indices showing resilience. Crude oil prices are stable around $80/barrel. RBI policy is expected to maintain status quo. Key earnings announcements have largely been positive, supporting the rally.

midcp_analysis.text_summary: MIDCPNIFTY futures closed at 51,200, up 1.5% for the week. Open Interest (OI) has increased by 10% in the last 5 sessions, suggesting fresh buying interest. The basis is at a slight premium, indicating bullish sentiment. Key support is at 50,000 (psychological, 50-DMA) and resistance at 52,000 (all-time high). Option chain data shows significant put writing at 50,000 and call writing at 52,500. PCR is 1.1, indicating a bullish bias. Max Pain is at 51,000. Unusual activity includes substantial call buying in the 51,500 strike.

sectoral_option_flows.text_summary: Banking sector shows strong call option buying, with PCR at 1.3 and significant OI buildup at 50,000 and 51,000 strikes. IT sector has mixed flows; PCR is 0.9, with some put writing at 15,000 and call writing at 16,000. Auto sector shows bullish bias with PCR at 1.2 and OI buildup at 25,000 strike. Pharma sector has neutral flows, PCR at 1.0. Realty sector shows increased put writing at 400 strike, PCR 0.8, indicating caution.

x_sentiment.text_summary: Trader sentiment on X is predominantly bullish, with many discussions focused on Nifty's potential to breach 23,500. There's buzz around strong FII inflows and positive earnings. Some caution is expressed regarding the high Nifty PE and potential for a short-term correction. Bank Nifty sentiment is also positive, driven by strong banking sector option flows. MIDCPNIFTY sentiment is cautiously optimistic, with focus on the 51,000-52,000 range.

one_week_outlook.base_case: Nifty is likely to consolidate in the 23200-23600 range, with a slight upward bias. Positive FII flows and strong sectoral momentum in Banking and Auto are supportive. Key resistance at 23,600 needs to be breached decisively for further upside. A close above 23,600 could trigger a move towards 23,700.
one_week_outlook.bull_case: A strong breakout above 23,600, driven by sustained FII buying and positive global cues, could push Nifty towards 23,700-23,800. This scenario is supported by strong option chain data showing call writing at higher strikes, which could be unwound.
one_week_outlook.bear_case: Profit booking emerges at higher levels, or negative global news triggers a sell-off. Nifty could fall back to the 23,200 support, potentially testing the 50-DMA at 23,000. High PE valuations make the market vulnerable to corrections.
